content:
The [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Convert hourly pay to weekly, monthly and annual salary. Enter your hourly wage, hours per week and weeks worked per year and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Convert an hourly wage into annual, monthly and weekly pay to compare job offers on equal terms. Figures are gross, before tax and deductions. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Finance tools include [Loan Calculator](/loan-calculator), [Mortgage Calculator](/mortgage-calculator) and [Car Loan Calculator](/car-loan-calculator). People also look for this tool as "hourly to salary calculator", "annual salary calculator", "wage calculator".

## How to use the Salary Calculator

Start by entering your hourly wage, then entering your hours per week and finally entering your weeks worked per year. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your hourly wage.
2. Enter your hours per week.
3. Enter your weeks worked per year.
4. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
5. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Annual = hourly rate × hours per week × weeks per year.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. 25 an hour at 40 hours a week for 52 weeks is 52,000 a year — about 4,333 a month. Try the same figures in the [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Hourly wage: 25, Hours per week: 40, Weeks worked per year: 52), the [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) returns Annual salary: 52,000, Monthly: 4,333.33, Bi-weekly: 2,000, Weekly: 1,000. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Loan Calculator](/loan-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Quick rule: double the hourly rate and add three zeros (25 → ~50,000).
- Factor in paid vacation and benefits when comparing offers.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### How many working hours are in a year?

A full-time 40-hour week over 52 weeks is 2,080 hours. Try it with your own numbers in the [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Is this take-home pay?

No, it's gross pay before taxes, retirement contributions and other deductions. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) and start straight away.

### What formula does the Salary Calculator use?

Annual = hourly rate × hours per week × weeks per year. You can see it in action in the [Salary Calculator](/salary-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Salary Calculator?

Just Hourly wage, Hours per week and Weeks worked per year. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.

### Does the Salary Calculator save or send my data?

No. The Salary Calculator runs entirely in your browser — the values you enter never leave your device. You can use it as often as you like, and because nothing is uploaded, stored or tracked, there is nothing to delete afterwards.
